name: tokensip-monorepo
description: TokenSip — the token-saving AI gateway. Cut LLM costs without changing model behavior.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tokensip/core && npm run build -w @tokensip/web && npm run build -w tokensip
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tokensip/core && npm run dev -w tokensip
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
